payload.title: Calculating Shifted Correlations
payload.description: This notebook demonstrates the use of Pyleoclim to calculate correlations between oxygen isotope data from Leviathan cave and insolation data across various latitudes and seasons. It includes defining a function to handle correlations in datasets with large gaps, creating insolation curves using Climlab, and calculating correlations between shifted insolation and isotope data. The notebook concludes with plotting the results to visualize the relationship.
